questions.questionText: A ball moves at 3 m/s for 4 seconds. How far does it travel?
In the formula d = v × t, what does 'v' represent?
questions.explanation: 'v' stands for velocity, which is the speed of the object.

questions.questionText: A ball travels 15 metres in 5 seconds. What is its speed?
If you double the speed of the ball, what happens to the distance in the same time?
questions.explanation: Since d = v × t, doubling v while keeping t the same doubles d.

questions.questionText: What unit is speed measured in for this simulation?
questions.explanation: In this lesson, speed is shown in metres per second (m/s).
